attchmntText: Om Freight Forwarders Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Statements for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Om Freight Forwarders Limited published newspaper advertisements on November 15, 2026, regarding its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Statements for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were adopted by the Board of Directors on November 13, 2026. Kosamattam Finance Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the same period on November 13, 2026. Yamini Investments Company Limited reported Standalone Unaudited Results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. Aadi Industries Limited reported Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Sarveshwar Foods Limited published Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and period ended September 30, 2026. Reilly Homes Realty Private Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Om Freight Forwarders Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Om Freight Forwarders Limited announced the approval of its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the statements on November 13, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, stood at 202.60 crore rupees, with a profit after tax of 8.57 crore rupees. For the half-year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 395.95 crore rupees, and profit after tax was 15.64 crore rupees. The company completed its initial public offering of 18,10,042 equity shares at 135 rupees per share, raising 24.44 crore rupees. The IPO proceeds were fully utilized during the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The statutory auditors issued a limited review report with no qualifications.
